title: Zigud
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: The familiar proverb refers to him: “Tuvia sinned, and Zigud is flogged,” as in [Pesachim 113b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.113b.3) and [Makkot 11a](https://www.sefaria.org/Makkot.11a.15). Zigud appeared before Rav Papa and testified on his own that Tuvia had sinned. Rav Papa had Zigud flogged.[^1]

notes.text: In Pesachim, Rav Papa explains that Zigud’s testimony by itself could only damage Tuvia’s reputation. In Makkot the proverb illustrates an objection about someone suffering for another person’s conduct.
